mapper.sql: id, plan_id, cost_ver, effective_from, effective_to, content_hash, status, maker_id, checker_id, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_channel_cost_plan_ver WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND cost_ver = #{costVer}
SELECT FROM t_channel_cost_plan_ver WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND cost_ver = #{costVer} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM t_channel_cost_plan_ver WHERE plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY cost_ver DESC

SELECT v.id AS cost_ver_id, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS scope_count, COUNT(c.id) AS component_count FROM t_channel_cost_plan_ver v LEFT JOIN t_channel_cost_scope s ON s.cost_ver_id = v.id LEFT JOIN t_channel_cost_component c ON c.scope_id = s.id WHERE v.plan_id = #{planId} GROUP BY v.id

SELECT FROM t_channel_cost_plan_ver WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE') AND effective_from <= #{occurredAt} AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > #{occurredAt}) ORDER BY cost_ver
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(cost_ver), 0) + 1 FROM t_channel_cost_plan_ver WHERE plan_id = #{planId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_channel_cost_plan_ver WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND status IN ('DRAFT', 'PENDING_APPROVAL')
